Beyond the obvious · twice-weekly edit

Unusual London events,
this week.

Discover free and affordable things to do in London this week and weekend, selected for unusual access, local character and a story worth following. Every listing is checked against the official organiser before publication.

Friday 2 October – Sunday 4 October · Last edited 28 September at 09:43

The complete edit

7 verified events
Friday 2 October1 event
Local culture £15

12:00–18:00

Spotlight on Nigeria at the V&A

A six-hour programme of curator talks, object handling, artist conversations and gallery tours explores Nigerian textiles, ceramics, design, photography and cultural histories.

Venue
V&A South Kensington, Learning Centre
Address
Cromwell Road, London, SW7 2RL
Access
Booking required
Check official details ↗
Saturday 3 October3 events
Heritage & history Free

10:00–17:00

Free Heritage Buses on Route 106

Routemasters, RTs and other preserved buses from the 1950s to 1970s carry passengers free between Finsbury Park and Ash Grove, with real conductors and no booking.

Venue
Route 106: Finsbury Park to Ash Grove
Address
Finsbury Park Interchange, Station Place to Ash Grove Garage, Mare Street, N4 2DH
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Local culture Free

11:00–15:30

Harvest Festival at Morden Hall Park

Apple pressing, Black Swan Border Morris, folk music, pollinator displays, crafts and a nature-themed Punch and Judy animate the Stableyard and park.

Venue
Morden Hall Park, Stableyard
Address
Morden Hall Road, Morden, London, SM4 5JD
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Heritage & history Free; donations welcome

14:00–17:00

London Sewing Machine Museum Open Day

Balham's rarely opened private museum reveals more than 600 machines, including an 1865 model presented to Queen Victoria's eldest daughter, in its monthly three-hour opening.

Venue
London Sewing Machine Museum
Address
308 Balham High Road, London, SW17 7AA
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Sunday 4 October3 events
Local culture Free

10:00–20:00

Japan Matsuri at Trafalgar Square

A one-day festival fills Trafalgar Square with taiko, traditional dance, martial arts, workshops, an anime cosplay catwalk and Japanese food and craft stalls.

Venue
Trafalgar Square
Address
Trafalgar Square, London, WC2N 5DS
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Architecture Free

10:30–16:30

Little Holland House Open Day

Step inside Frank Dickinson's self-built Arts and Crafts home, where his handmade furniture, paintings, carvings, metalwork and Art Nouveau interiors remain in place.

Venue
Little Holland House
Address
40 Beeches Avenue, Carshalton, SM5 3LW
Access
Booking recommended
Check official details ↗
Heritage & history £3 adult advance; £4 door

11:00–16:00

Apple Day at Fulham Palace

Orchard tours reveal Fulham Palace's heritage apple varieties alongside the harvest market, garden games, baking competition, local food, crafts and live music.

Venue
Fulham Palace
Address
Bishop's Avenue, Fulham, London, SW6 6EA
Access
Booking recommended
